title: 18-Inch Towel Bar Wall Mount, Powder Coated Pipe | Pink | Pipeline Collection | Allied Brass
body_html:
Stop draping towels over doors and counters—this 18-Inch towel bar keeps bath towels neatly hung, within reach, and off the floor while adding an industrial pipe-fitting detail to your bathroom in Pink, which brings playful, modern energy to bathroom design, offering a fresh take on hardware that celebrates individuality.

  • Pink transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 76 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Maintain a clean, decorative finish with a highly durable powder coat.
  • Built for lasting performance with corrosion-free and rust-free materials.
  • Install with a matched look using color-coordinated mounting hardware.

Specs & Installation

  • Product dimensions (L x H x W): 18 x 3 x 3.3 in.
  • Box dimensions (L x H x W): 24 x 5 x 5 in.
  • Shipping weight: 2.2 lbs
  • Finish: powder coated (finish varies by selection)
  • Warranty: limited lifetime warranty
